admission.justification: Spans knowledge_writer/deferrals.py, tasks/task_facts.py, and knowledge_writer/authoring.py, and is guarded by seven targeted writer tests.

applicability: Every dependent record write through knowledge_write or knowledge-ingest on converted memory.
conditions: Condition task IDs are checked against live and archived canonical task documents via load_task_facts, refusing unknown, master, or terminal tasks.
Re-deferral requires a changed task or file condition or a moved candidate fileBlob on the same file, refusing note-only re-deferrals.
Any write that lifts a deferral must record a deferral_lifted history row and cannot combine lift with confirmation.
Confirming a dependent (new or existing) with open deferrals is refused unless the leaf edited the document, naming every open deferral's ID, owner, passage, and reason.
exclusions: Direct authoring of the raw deferrals list outside a crossing sync resolution.
Post-sync unedited confirmations introduced by a merge, which are caught by the closeout gate.
statement: knowledge_write executes defer, redefer (allowing same-file re-defer with the new blob when due by changed fileBlob and refusing note-only re-deferrals), lift (requiring a deferral_lifted history row so MQC surfaces every lift), and partial resolveDeferrals on edited confirmations, refuses invalid task/file/passage/reason inputs against coordination task documents, and refuses confirming any dependent document (new or existing) with an open deferral without an edit while naming all open deferrals.
title: knowledge_write validates deferrals, lift rows, and unedited confirmations
